versions.changelog:
Initial release of the search-huggingface skill.

- Enables searching Hugging Face models based on user's queries.
- Uses the user's query to construct and open the appropriate Hugging Face models search URL.
- Focuses the existing Brave browser and attempts to reuse relevant tabs.
- Navigates only; does not submit forms, purchase, or modify accounts.
- Respects authentication boundaries and privacy; informs user if login is required.
